newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco rises 4 pct ahead of report.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco rises 4 pct ahead of report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish engineering group Atlas Copco were trading over four percent higher on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Wednesday ahead of the group's six-month earnings report, due around midday.
At 0910 GMT, the share was up 10 crowns at 244 while the exchange's general index was 0.91 percent higher at 3,191.32.
"The new chief executive (Giulio Mazzalupi) is fairly expansive, so there are some expectations on that report," a dealer said.
Another dealer attributed the share rise to index trading.
"Atlas Copco is part of some indices and the share is probably rising as people buy futures," a trader said.
Atlas Copco is expected to post a profit after financial items of 1.55 billion crowns for the first half of 1997 against 1.57 billion crowns a year ago, a Reuters poll found.
